input: Am I eligible for a security escort on a 9:00 PM drop?
expected: Yes, security escort is mandatory for female employees on drops scheduled after 20:00 (v1) / 20:30 (v2).
actual: Under revised Policy v2, a security escort guard is mandatory for female employees on drops scheduled after 20:30 (8:30 PM). [Document: NexusPay_Commute_Policy_v2, Section: 3. Night Shift and Female Employee Safety Escort]
notes: Grounded night escort rule with valid citations

input: Am I eligible for a security escort on a 9:30 PM drop?
expected: Yes, security escort is mandatory for all employees (regardless of gender) for drops scheduled after 21:00 (9:00 PM).
actual: A security escort is mandatory for all employees (regardless of gender) for drops scheduled after 21:00 (9:00 PM) or pickups prior to 05:00. [Document: AeroLogix_Commute_Policy_v1, Section: 3. Night Shift Security Escort Protocol]
notes: Grounded night escort rule with valid citations

input: Am I eligible for an escort on a 9:30 PM drop?
expected: No, security escort is only mandatory for female employees on drops scheduled after 22:00 (10:00 PM). Drops between 18:00 and 22:00 do not require an escort.
actual: A security guard escort is mandatory for female employees on drops scheduled after 22:00 (10:00 PM). Drops prior to 22:00 do not require an escort unless flagged. [Document: CloudMatrix_Commute_Policy_v1, Section: 3. Late Night Commute and Safety Guard Escort]
notes: Grounded night escort rule with valid citations

input: What is AeroLogix's policy on night escorts?

input: Can I book a cab on Saturday for urgent work?
expected: Weekend cab allocations are restricted to critical production support and require manager approval (or senior director in v2) 24 hours in advance.
actual: Weekend cabs require prior written approval from a Senior Director at least 24 hours in advance for critical production support. [Document: NexusPay_Commute_Policy_v2, Section: 4. Ad-Hoc and Weekend Cab Allocations]
notes: Grounded weekend transport rule with valid citations

input: Can I book a cab on Saturday if my manager approves?
expected: Weekend cabs are strictly prohibited across all departments without exception. Managers cannot authorize weekend cabs.
actual: Weekend cabs are strictly prohibited across all departments without exception; employees must use self-conveyance and claim reimbursement. [Document: AeroLogix_Commute_Policy_v1, Section: 4. Weekend and Holiday Travel]
notes: Grounded weekend transport rule with valid citations

input: What is the cutoff time to book an evening logout cab?
expected: The cutoff time for evening logout cabs is 15:00 (3:00 PM) on the same day.
actual: The evening logout cutoff is 15:00 (3:00 PM) on the same day, while morning login cutoff is 18:00 on the preceding day. [Document: NexusPay_Commute_Policy_v2, Section: 2. Shift Timings and Cutoff Schedules]
notes: Grounded cutoff window with valid citations

input: What is the cutoff time to request an evening cab?
expected: The cutoff time for evening and night logout cabs is strictly 17:00 (5:00 PM) on the day of travel.
actual: The cutoff time for requesting or modifying evening and night logout cabs is strictly 17:00 (5:00 PM) on the day of commute. [Document: AeroLogix_Commute_Policy_v1, Section: 2. Shift Timings and Cutoff Windows]
notes: Grounded cutoff window with valid citations

input: By what time must I book my evening cab?
expected: The cutoff time for evening logout cabs is 12:00 PM (Noon) on the day of commute.
actual: 2.2 Morning login cabs must be finalized by 20:00 (8:00 PM) on the prior evening.. [Document: CloudMatrix_Commute_Policy_v1, Section: 2. Cut-off Schedule]

input: What happens if I miss my cab and no-show twice?
expected: Upon the 2nd unexcused no-show, a penalty of ₹250 (v1) / ₹500 (v2) is deducted from monthly payroll.
actual: Upon the 2nd unexcused no-show in a quarter, a penalty of ₹500 will be deducted from monthly payroll. [Document: NexusPay_Commute_Policy_v2, Section: 3. Night Shift and Female Employee Safety Escort]
notes: Grounded no-show penalty with valid citations

input: What is the penalty if I no-show once?
expected: The 1st unexcused no-show leads to an automatic suspension of transport privileges for one calendar week.
actual: The 1st unexcused no-show leads to automatic suspension of transport privileges for one calendar week; the 2nd revokes allocation for the quarter. [Document: AeroLogix_Commute_Policy_v1, Section: 6. No-Show Penalties and Disciplinary Action]
notes: Grounded no-show penalty with valid citations
